answer: Proof-of-stake registration with slashing is how an agent economy stops Sybil attacks. An agent locks collateral to open an identity, and weight comes from stake, not key count, so a thousand sock puppets funded from one wallet carry only that wallet's weight. Slashing closes the arbitrage: when a cluster is caught, every stake traceable to it burns on the funding wallet. A thousand-agent attack needs six figures of locked stake and forfeits it all, while an honest operator risks one refundable bond. That gap makes an umber dune of clones unprofitable while a willow of honest stake stands.
